summary: SUI Group Holdings Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting the approval of a form of Indemnification Agreement for directors and officers, a standard corporate governance matter, and the appointment of Kristina Campbell as an independent director and audit committee chair. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is routine and not classified as a special situation. No deal terms are present; the summary reflects ordinary board actions and compensatory arrangements.
